source_refs.note: 4. Substrate Concentration: a main subheading of 5.4 Factors affecting the rate of enzyme action, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 136-136.

blocks.text: Agar enzyme molecules ki active sites khali hon to substrate ki concentration barhane se reaction ki raftar barhti hai. Agar enzyme ki miqdar ek jaisi rakhi jaye aur substrate barhaya jaye to ek aisa nuqta aata hai jis ke baad substrate barhane se raftar mazeed nahin barhti.

Jab enzyme molecules khali hon (substrate kam ho) to naye substrate molecules khali active sites se jurte hain aur diye gaye waqt mein zyada products bante hain, yani raftar barhti hai. Lekin jab tamam active sites bhar jayen (substrate zyada ho) to mazeed substrate molecules ko khali jagah nahin milti, is liye raftar nahin barhti (Fig. 5.8).

blocks.alt: Reaction ki raftar aur substrate ki concentration ka graph. Lakeer origin se seedhi barhti hai, phir mur kar nuqtedar satah ke saath seedhi chalti hai; mor par teer ke saath likha hai No more active sites for substrate.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Enzyme ki miqdar yahan mustaqil hai. Shuru mein khali active sites hain, to zyada substrate se raftar barhti hai. Mor par tamam active sites bhar chuki hain (saturation); ab mazeed substrate ko khali site nahin milti, is liye raftar aage nahin barhti.

blocks.prompt: Bonds ki madad se samjhayen ke thanda karna enzyme ko sust kyun karta hai jabke optimum se kahin zyada garam karna use bilkul rok deta hai, aur thermophilic bacteria 70 degree Celsius par kaise zinda rehte hain.
blocks.explanation: Thanda karna hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic taalluqat ko sakht kar deta hai, to active site induced tabdeeli nahin kar pata, aur raftar girti hai magar enzyme salamat rehta hai. Shadeed garmi atoms ko itni shiddat se tharthrati hai ke yeh bonds zanjeeron ko apni jagah nahin rakh pate; globular shakal khatam ho jati hai (denaturation) aur sargarmi ruk jati hai. Thermophilic bacteria ke proteins ki polypeptide bazuon ke darmiyan bonding zyada mazboot hai, is liye un ke enzymes 70 degree ya zyada par apni shakal rakhte hain.

items: Temperature: insani enzymes ka optimum 37 °C; is se neeche bonds sakht aur raftar kam; is se bohat upar denaturation se globular shakal khatam. Thermophilic bacteria 70 °C ya zyada par kaam karte hain.

pH: har enzyme ka apna tang optimum pH (pepsin 1.5–1.6, trypsin 7.8–8.7; papain dono mahol mein); pH badalne se active site aur substrate ka ionization badalta hai, aur shadeed pH enzyme ko denature karta hai.

Enzyme ki concentration: substrate wafir ho to raftar enzyme ke saath barhti hai, phir ek jaisi ho jati hai. Substrate ki concentration: khali active sites tak raftar barhti hai, sab bhar jayen to barhna band.
